questions.question:
Arrange the given words in the sequence in which they occur in the dictionary.

1. Decollete

2. Desecrate

3. Decorous

4. Desipicable

5. Destitute
questions.solution:

3. __Deco**r**__ous

2. __De**s**__crate

4. __Des**i**__picable

questions.question:
In the following question, correct the given equation by interchanging two numbers.

8 × 3 ÷ 4 + 9 – 5 = 16
questions.solution:
**Given equation:**

8 × 3 ÷ 4 + 9 – 5 = 16

**On interchanging,**

1) 3 and 4 → 8 × 4 ÷ 3 + 9 – 5 → 14.67 ≠ 16

2) 4 and 8 → 4 × 3 ÷ 8 + 9 – 5 → 5.5 ≠ 16

3) 5 and 3 → 8 × 5 ÷ 4 + 9 – 3 → **16 = 16**

4) 5 and 9 → 8 × 3 ÷ 4 + 5 – 9 → 2 ≠ 16

Hence, on interchanging ‘5 and 3’ we’ll get the correct answer.

questions.question: If (2)# * 4 = 2 and (4)# * 4 = 16, then what is the value of A in (6)# * A = 18?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

(2)# * 4 = 2

→ (2)³/4 → 8/4 = 2

(4)# * 4 = 16

→ (4)³/ 4 → 64/4 = 16

Similarly,

(6)# * A = 18

→ (6)³/A = 18

→ 216/A = 18

→ 12 = A

Therefore, the correct answer is 12.

questions.question: 5 year hence, ratio of ages of A and B will be 7 : 5 and difference between their ages will be 4 years. What are present ages (in years) of A and B respectively?
questions.solution:
5 year hence, let the ages of A and B be 7x and 5x.

And, differences between their ages will be 4 years → 7x – 5x = 4

→ x = 2

Present ages of A and B would be (7x – 5) and (5x – 5) respectively.

Therefore, A’s age = 9 and B’s age = 5.

questions.question: In which city is the Forest Research Institute of India located?
questions.solution:
• The Forest Research Institute of India is located in Dehradun, the capital city of the northern Indian state of Uttarakhand.
 
• The institute was established in 1906 and is one of the oldest and most prestigious institutions in India dedicated to forestry research, education, and training.
 
• It is spread over 450 hectares and includes a museum, herbarium, arboretum, and several research centers and laboratories.
 
• The Forest Research Institute of India is a leading center for forestry research and education in the country and plays a crucial role in the conservation and sustainable management of India's forest resources.

questions.solution:

• After one half life, we will have ½ of the substance remaining. After another half life, we will have ¼ of the substance remaining. It means 3/4th of the substance will decay after two half lives.

1 Half life = 6 months

2 Half lives = 12 months

questions.question: It is difficult to fix a nail on a freely suspended wooden frame. Which law supports this statement?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Newton's third law**__

It is difficult to fix a nail on a freely suspended wooden frame. This is because of Newton's third law of motion. When we apply a force on the frame, It gets deflected due to the reaction of applied force. 

__Concept:__

Newton’s First law:

 
• A body continues to be in its state of rest or of uniform motion along a straight line unless it is acted upon by some external force to change the state.
 
• If no net force acts on a body, then the velocity of the body cannot change i.e. the body cannot accelerate.
 
• Newton’s first law defines inertia and is rightly called the law of inertia.

 

Newton’s Second Law:

 
• The rate of change of linear momentum of a body is directly proportional to the external force applied on the body and this change takes place always in the direction of the applied force.
 
• If a body of mass m moves with velocity vec vthen its linear momentum can be given by vec p = mvec v and if force is applied on a body, then

therefore vec F = mvec a

Where F = Force, m = mass and a = acceleration

Newton’s Third Law:

 
• To every action, there is always an equal (in magnitude) and opposite (in direction) reaction.
 
• When a body exerts a force on any other body, the second body also exerts an equal and opposite force on the first.
 
• Forces in nature always occur in pairs. A single isolated force is not possible.

questions.question: Two people A and B are at a distance of 260 km from each other at 9 : 00 a.m. A immediately starts moving towards B at a speed of 25 km/h and at 11 : 00 a.m. B starts moving towards A at a speed of 10 km/hr. At what time (in p.m.) will they meet each other?
questions.solution:
Distance travelled by A from 9 am to 11 am .i.e. 2 hrs is

⇒ Distance = 25 × 2

⇒ 50 Kms

Now, remaining distance = (260 – 50)

⇒ 210 Kms is remaining distance between them

Relative speed = 25 + 10

⇒ relative speed = 35 km/hr

time taken by them to cover 210 Kms is

⇒ 210/35

⇒ 6 hours

∴ they will meet at 6 hours from 11 am i.e. at 5 pm

questions.question: A, B and C are three students. A got 18% more marks than B and 12% less than C. If B got 220 marks, then how much marks C has got?
questions.solution:
Given that B got 220 marks

⇒ A got 18% more that of B’s marks

⇒ A’s marks = 220 × (1 + 18/100)

⇒ A’s marks = 220 × 1.18

⇒ A’s marks = 259.6

Given that A’s marks are 12% less than that of C

⇒ A’s marks = 12% less than that of C

⇒ C’s marks × (1 – 12/100) = 259.6

⇒ C’s marks = 259.6/0.88

∴ C’s marks are 295

Squaring both side

Subtracting both side by 2

⇒ x + 7 - 1/(x + 7) = √45

⇒ x - 1/(x + 7) = √45 - 7

**∴ The value of x – [1/(x + 7)] is √45 - 7.**

questions.question:

Opprobrium

• **Examples:**
 
 
• The actor's performance was met with great **adulation **from the audience.
 
• The politician's decision to accept the bribe was met with public **opprobrium**.

• **Examples:**
 
 
• The athlete suffered **ignominy **when she was caught using performance-enhancing drugs.
 
• The **mystical **atmosphere of the ancient temple filled the tourists with a sense of awe.
 
• The lack of funding will **preclude **the construction of the new library.
 
 
 
• Note that options 2, 3, and 4 are all unrelated to the meaning of "opprobrium."

questions.question: If so, English is perhaps the most _____ lens through which to see animals.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**distorting**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, '**distorting**' is the most fitting word to complete the sentence "If so, English is perhaps the most _____ lens through which to see animals."
 
• The word 'distorting' refers to the act of twisting or altering something out of its true, natural, or original state.
 
• The context implies that the English language may create a skewed or misrepresented view of animals.
 
• Hence, the correct answer will be **Option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• '**Distorting**' means giving a misleading or false account or impression of something. It fits the context best, as it suggests that the English language may change or warp the way animals are seen.

 
 
• Example sentence: The mirror was distorting his reflection.
 
 
 
• '**Disturbing**' means causing distress or worry or upsetting. This doesn't fit into the context of the lens or perspective through which we see animals.
 
 
• Example sentence: It was a disturbing news report.
 
 
 
• '**Popular**' means liked or admired by many people or by a particular person or group. This doesn't fit into the context of the sentence which implies a characteristic of the lens, not its popularity.
 
 
• Example sentence: She's a popular singer among teenagers.
 
 
 
• '**Useful**' means able to be used for a practical purpose or in several ways. In this context, it doesn't fit as it doesn't imply any form of alteration or misrepresentation in the way animals are seen.
 
 
• Example sentence: This guidebook is very useful for new travelers.

questions.question: Animal _____ imply baseness and vulgarity.

__
 
• In the given context, '**instincts**' would be the most fitting word to complete the sentence "Animal _____ imply baseness and vulgarity."

• In reference to animals, it could mean behaviors driven by primal urges or natural tendencies.
 
• Hence, the correct answer will be **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• '**Gestures**' means the use of motions of the limbs or body as a means of expression, usually related to humans and not commonly used for animals.
 
 
• **Example sentence: **The politician's gestures were animated as he delivered his speech.
 
 
 
• '**Instincts**' refers to an innate, typically fixed pattern of behavior in animals in response to certain stimuli. In the context of the sentence, this could imply baseness and vulgarity because it refers to the inherent, often unrefined behaviors of animals.
 
 
• **Example sentence: **Cats have an instinct to hunt.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. **

She has not been (1)/ to the restaurant (2)/ much late. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. 3.

‘Much late’ is grammatically incorrect and must be replaced with ‘of late’ which signifies the event or the actions which happened a short time ago or recently. For example, His life has changed of late.

Hence, the statement can be correctly rewritten as She has not been to the restaurant of late.
